title: Enhancing histology education: Iranian medical students’ experience with eHistoLab web-application virtual microscopy
reason: Two-group pre/post comparison of histology knowledge (eHistoLab virtual microscopy vs e-lecturing) plus preference percentages. LMS only delivers materials; no per-student platform indicator is related to outcomes.

extraction.n_quote: A total of 100 medical, dentistry, and pharmacy students enrolled in a histology course at Smart University of Medical Sciences (SMUMS), Iran, during the summer semester of 2023 participated in the study.
extraction.population: medical, dentistry and pharmacy students, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none (LMS and app used for delivery)
extraction.notes: Cohen's d = 1.31 is a pre-post/group effect, not an indicator-outcome relation.
